fields.Name: T274 - Lists Shared With Me Surface
fields.Description: Renders the dedicated shared-with-me surface backed by the ListSharingService shared-lists query — a distinct data path (lists NOT owned by the current user) from the owner-scoped Browse/My Lists surfaces.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, select the Lists application, and open the 'Shared With Me' section from its left nav. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Success is that the 'Shared With Me' surface renders — showing lists that other users have shared with you OR a clear empty state indicating nothing is shared with you yet. Seeing the surface render (either populated or empty) is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: The 'Shared With Me' surface renders with its header and either a list of shared lists or a valid empty state
The surface loads fully (no perpetual loading spinner)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
